About.title: Fourteen years above someone's panel — usually right before something burns out.
About.lead: I started rewiring my own flat in 2010 because two electricians gave me three different problems for the same fault. Since 2012 it's been my only job. Apartments, houses, shops, light industry — work where the test report matters more than the cheapest quote.

About.quote: “Show me the panel before you give a quote.” That's the whole philosophy. If we don't see it, we don't price it.
